records.source: A movie? Sure, sounds fun! I'll meet you at the theater.$h#$e#I hope it's an exciting one.
records.translation: Pelikula? Sige, mukhang masaya! Magkita tayo sa sinehan.$h#$e#Sana ay kapana-panabik iyon.

records.source: A movie ticket? Yes, I'd love to go with you! I'll meet you at the theater, honey.$h
records.translation: Tiket sa Sine? Oo, gusto kong sumama sa iyo! Magkita tayo sa sinehan, mahal.$h

records.source: Oooh... date night, huh? Let me just freshen up a little and I'll meet you at the theater.$h
records.translation: Oooh... gabi ng date, ha? Mag-aayos lang ako nang kaunti at magkita tayo sa sinehan.$h

records.source: A movie ticket! You know, I was thinking about the movies all day. You must've read my mind! $h#$e#I'll meet you at the theater.
records.translation: Tiket sa Sine! Alam mo, buong araw kong iniisip ang mga pelikula. Nabasa mo yata ang isip ko! $h#$e#Magkita tayo sa sinehan.

records.source: Oh, a movie? Sure, sounds fun.... It'll be like we're dating again, hehe.$h#$e#I'll meet you at the theater.
records.translation: O, pelikula? Sige, mukhang masaya.... Para tayong nagde-date ulit, hehe.$h#$e#Magkita tayo sa sinehan.

records.source: Oh! You planned a date night for us? $h#$b#I'd love to go! I'll see you at the theater.$h
records.translation: O! Nagplano ka ng gabi ng date para sa atin? $h#$b#Gusto kong sumama! Kita tayo sa sinehan.$h

records.source: Hey, sounds fun! I've been wanting to see this one... and I'd rather see it with you!#$b#I'll meet you at the theater.
records.translation: Hoy, mukhang masaya! Gusto ko nang mapanood ito... at mas gusto kong kasama ka!#$b#Magkita tayo sa sinehan.

records.source: Nice! You got us tickets? You're the best! I'll wait for you at the theater.$h
records.translation: Ayos! Kumuha ka ng mga tiket natin? Ikaw talaga ang pinakamahusay! Hihintayin kita sa sinehan.$h

records.source: Oh, you want to go to the movies? Sounds pretty good. I'll meet you there.$h
records.translation: O, gusto mong manood ng pelikula? Mukhang maganda iyan. Magkita tayo roon.$h

records.source: Oh, you want to see a show, huh? Buy me a snack and it's a deal, hehe...$h#$e#I'll meet you there.
records.translation: O, gusto mong manood ng palabas, ha? Ilibre mo ako ng meryenda at payag ako, hehe...$h#$e#Magkita tayo roon.

records.source: Yes, my dear, I'd love to see a movie with you! I'll meet you at the theater.
records.translation: Oo, mahal ko, gustong-gusto kong manood ng pelikula kasama ka! Magkita tayo sa sinehan.

records.source: Movie tickets? Well... yes, I'd love to go with you!$h#$e#It's good to do things like this, I don't want married life to get boring for you!
records.translation: Mga tiket sa pelikula? Buweno... oo, gusto kong sumama sa iyo!$h#$e#Mabuting gumawa tayo ng mga ganitong bagay, ayaw kong magsawa ka sa buhay-may-asawa!

records.source: Hey, it's Robin. I'm out of the house today for my weekly aerobics club... Sorry! *beep*
records.translation: Hoy, si Robin ito. Wala ako sa bahay ngayon para sa lingguhan kong samahan ng aerobics... Paumanhin! *beep*

records.translation: Hoy, si Robin ito. Wala ako sa bahay hanggang bukas dahil tinatapos ko ang isang proyekto. *beep*

records.source: Hey, it's Robin. I'll be busy for the next few days working on a project. *beep*
records.translation: Hoy, si Robin ito. Magiging abala ako sa susunod na ilang araw sa paggawa ng isang proyekto. *beep*

records.source: Hey, it's Robin. I'm taking the day off today. Sorry for the inconvenience! *beep*
